import asyncio

from seed import AsyncSeedPythonGlobalHeaderClientDefault

client = AsyncSeedPythonGlobalHeaderClientDefault(
    client_id="YOUR_CLIENT_ID",
    version="2024-01-01",
    secret="YOUR_SECRET",
    base_url="https://yourhost.com/path/to/api",
)


async def main() -> None:
    await client.service.get_with_api_version()


asyncio.run(main())
